title: Action
description: A single browser action the extension should execute.

target.description: Identifier of the page element to act on.

value.description: Literal value to use (for select, or non-sensitive fill). Prefer value_source for private data.

value_source.description: Local profile reference resolved only by the extension. E.g. local_profile.email or local_profile.resume.

key.description: Key or key combination for press_key.

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds for wait actions.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector hint for the element.
